definitions: The measurement or extent of something from end to end.
The amount of time that something lasts.
A piece or section of something, especially when cut or torn from a larger amount.
The full extent of something, especially a period of time or a course of action.
examples: The length of the room is five metres.
The film had a running length of two hours.
She bought a length of fabric.
He spoke at length about his travels.
